set.body: Add JVM-only readers for FreeSurfer ASCII and binary geometry into SurfaceGeometry, keeping the shared model parser-free. Acceptance: ASCII reader handles std.8-style files with 0-based faces, binary reader validates magic/counts/short reads, hemisphere inference is explicit and test-covered, and IO errors return/throw stable messages. Likely paths: modules/surface/jvm/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/io, modules/surface/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface/io, modules/surface/jvm/src/test/resources.
set.title: JVM FreeSurfer surface geometry IO
